title: 信诺高管：香港新加坡双城记，人才是核心竞争力
speaker: Jason Salar

segments.en: Yeah, so earlier this year, we celebrated 15 years of operating in Singapore. Again, we've got a very successful business there.
segments.zh: 今年早些时候，我们庆祝了在新加坡运营15周年。我们在那里拥有非常成功的业务。

segments.en: One of the positives about both Hong Kong and Singapore is the wealth of talent. There's also a lot of competition for talent.
segments.zh: 香港和新加坡的共同优势之一是人才济济，但人才竞争也非常激烈。

segments.en: But I think we've been very fortunate in always been able to attract and retain good talent. And at the end of the day, we are a people business and talent is key.
segments.zh: 但我们很幸运，一直能够吸引和留住优秀人才。归根结底，我们是一个以人为本的行业，人才是关键。

segments.en: OK, you sponsored high rocks. I could ask the end. You sponsored it last year. You're a sponsor at this year, too?
segments.zh: 你们赞助了High Rocks活动。去年你们是赞助商，今年也是吗？

segments.en: I'll find out from the local team who I'm spending some time with. I don't know at the moment.
segments.zh: 我会向当地团队了解，目前还不知道。

segments.en: All right. Well, anyway, it's very exciting. Seeing all these kind of brands really catch and really ride this whole wave when it comes to fitness and the like here. Jason, it's great to have you back in Hong Kong, Jason Sadler. They're a global president at Sigma Healthcare International Health.
segments.zh: 好的，无论如何，这非常令人兴奋。看到这些品牌在健身等领域引领潮流。Jason，欢迎回到香港，Jason Sadler，信诺国际健康全球总裁。
